description.p: Soplos Repo Selector manages APT software repositories for Soplos Linux: enable or disable repositories, modernize legacy .list files to DEB822 .sources, find the fastest mirrors with a real speed test, and manage GPG signing keys.

El Selector de Repositorios de Soplos gestiona los repositorios de software APT para Soplos Linux: activar o desactivar repositorios, modernizar archivos .list al formato DEB822 .sources, encontrar los espejos más rápidos con test de velocidad real y gestionar claves de firma GPG.

Le sélecteur de dépôts Soplos gère les dépôts logiciels APT pour Soplos Linux : activer ou désactiver des dépôts, convertir les anciens fichiers .list au format DEB822 .sources, trouver les miroirs les plus rapides et gérer les clés GPG.

Die Soplos Paketquellen-Auswahl verwaltet APT-Softwarequellen für Soplos Linux: Aktivieren oder Deaktivieren von Paketquellen, Modernisieren alter .list-Dateien in das DEB822 .sources-Format, Ermitteln der schnellsten Spiegelserver und Verwalten von GPG-Signaturschlüsseln.

O Seletor de Repositórios do Soplos gere os repositórios de software APT para o Soplos Linux: ativar ou desativar repositórios, modernizar ficheiros .list antigos para o formato DEB822 .sources, encontrar os espelhos mais rápidos e gerir chaves GPG.

Il Selettore di Repository di Soplos gestisce i repository software APT per Soplos Linux: attiva o disattiva repository, aggiorna i vecchi file .list al formato DEB822 .sources, trova i mirror più veloci e gestisce le chiavi di firma GPG.

Selectorul de depozite Soplos gestionează depozitele de software APT pentru Soplos Linux: activați sau dezactivați depozite, modernizați fișierele .list vechi în format DEB822 .sources, găsiți cele mai rapide oglinzi și gestionați cheile GPG.

Выбор репозиториев Soplos управляет репозиториями программ APT для Soplos Linux: включение и отключение репозиториев, перевод старых файлов .list в формат DEB822 .sources, поиск быстрейших зеркал с тестом скорости и управление ключами подписи GPG.

description.p: First stable release.
The application metadata points to the installed launcher.
The window no longer has the frame of the system: it is a card with rounded corners and its own minimize, maximize and close buttons.
New application icon, new hero image and new screenshots, taken with the interface in English.
The list of mirrors of the speed test no longer fights with the scroll of the page: the wheel stays inside the list.
The window follows the light or dark theme of the desktop (Xfce, Plasma and GNOME); the button of the sidebar still lets you choose.
Documentation and packaging fixes.

ul.li: Manual page rewritten for the three views (Repositories, Sources Generator and GPG Keys) and installed compressed
AppStream categories and keywords in 8 languages; developer and project group identifiers now org.soplos; screenshots use web addresses
Debian copyright declares Lucide (ISC), used for the interface icons

description.p: Full 8-language internationalization across desktop launchers and AppStream metadata.
Added Unix manual page documentation (soplos-repo-selector.1) installed to /usr/share/man/man1/.
Updated Debian packaging and application documentation.
Unused GPG key detection and an updated sidebar icon.

ul.li: GPG Keys now flags keys no repository references anymore and that don't belong to any installed package

description.p: Full architecture rewrite of Soplos Repo Selector, from Python 3 and GTK3 to Tauri 2 with a Rust backend and a Svelte frontend.
